-- REQ: LANG-081 LANG-082 LANG-083 LANG-084 LANG-085 /* Block comment /* nested */ still comment */ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order items" ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'it''s', price DECIMAL(10, 2) CHECK (price >= 0), created TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); select o.id, count(*) as n, coalesce(sum(o.price), 0.0) AS total, my_func(o.name) from "order items" o left join `select` s on s.id = o.id where o.name like N'%zażółć%' and o.price between 1 and 1e3 or o.flag is null group by o.id having count(*) > 1 order by total desc limit 10 offset 20; insert into t (a, b) values (X'FF', 'multi line');
